proof: Choose ANY high, apply complete host normal form and exclude every profile with first-two empty counts sum<=2. Each singleton empty degree<=2 gives high sums3or4. Sum49-4a excludes a8/a9, forces all3 at a7 and four4/three3 at a6. Singleton positivity (or sum>=3 with individual<=2) gives distinct high colours for the three a6 degree3 singletons. Pair empty degree<=1 and common-high incidences give s_i+degQ(i)=7, hence degR=s_i-1; a7 R is C7 or C3+C4.
